writeup.key_factor: Los Angeles is the NHL's only winless team (0-4-2) with the league's weakest attack (2.00 goals/game) and penalty kill (61.9%). The goalie matchup is confirmed and lopsided: Logan Thompson (4-2, .910 SV%) starts for Washington against Darcy Kuemper (0-3-1, 4.53 GAA, .847 SV%). Washington is 5-3 and 4-1 at home.
writeup.risk: The Kings' underlying chances (2.91 expected goals for per game) are better than their record, so positive regression is the main threat. Washington also allows a high shot volume. If the price drifts past -162 the edge is gone and the play should be passed.
